findings.reason: The algorithm indexes tableau coordinates and circuit wires from 0 to n−1, while lem-qc-cnot-pauli-action names factors 1 to n, with factor j at position j−1. The procedure and its termination and correctness proofs apply the CNOT action without stating this conversion. Specify the mapping, including the corresponding single-wire gates, in the procedure and consumer proofs.

The procedure maintains a binary row-operation matrix and separately tracks row phases, but calls the returned object a signed row-operation map; the correctness theorem likewise calls M signed. Define the exact returned map and phase data, and align the theorem with that interface.

The algorithm has an empty justified_by field, although thm-qc-stabilizer-encoder-terminates-with-quadratic-gate-count proves termination and depends on the algorithm. The algorithm instructions require linking the well-definedness result through justified_by.

Steps 1.2 and 2.1 establish independent columns of ∂₂ and independent rows of ∂₁, but steps 2.1–3.1 use the corresponding map ranks, including rank(∂₂ᵀ), without proving or citing the row-rank/column-rank equality. Step 3.2 also uses dim(ker ∂₁/im ∂₂) without establishing the quotient-dimension formula. Supply these finite-dimensional arguments locally; rank-nullity alone does not give the missing rank and quotient identities.

The Statement describes D† as acting on a logical basis vector |x⟩, but its defined action is only after padding as D†(|0ʳ⟩⊗|x⟩). State the encoding isometry explicitly and align its M description with the algorithm’s clarified output.

Step 3.1 establishes the phase-syndrome circuit for Zᵛ alone, while the Statement and step 5 cover general XᵘZᵛ errors. Explain that after Hadamards the Xᵘ component is diagonal Zᵘ and leaves the ancilla syndrome unchanged; likewise account for Zᵛ during the first extraction.

Step 6.1 swaps the check/component conditions: X checks from C₂ constrain v∈C₂⊥, and Z checks from C₁⊥ constrain u∈C₁. The combined normalizer condition is right, but the stated rationale is false. Define S as generated by these checks and, for k=0, derive C₁=C₂ by finite-dimensional equal-dimension inclusion so both logical difference sets are empty.

Step 3.1 of the distance theorem and step 8.1 of the CSS theorem give the one-qubit matrix expansion, then claim tensor products span the full multiqubit operator space from a product Hilbert-space basis. That supplier does not establish an operator-space basis. Add a matrix-unit expansion showing each global matrix unit lies in the span of tensor Pauli operators.
